requirement.value: Dowser (Invoker), Elementalist, Entropist or Symbolist mastery + Invocation

system.description: After an enemy you can see hits or misses you with an offensive spell, if the Result of their Magic Check was even, you may immediately use Invocation for free — after the spell fully resolves — against that enemy, spending no Mind Points. The invocation must not be a hex, may target only that enemy, and cannot use Linked Invocation. A reaction with a named trigger, a coin-flip gate and a target restriction; it passes the free-action rule without argument.
